story_overview: Following a tense encounter between Liam and Evan, a mysterious green satin jacket appears on different people, including Kai at a BBQ restaurant. Meanwhile, at her bustling noodle bar, Hana interacts with various patrons like Rohan and Sang-hoon. The story culminates with Liam having a serious street-side conversation with the imposing Jae-wook.
